selection: Complete official validation three-class Accuracy, then Macro-F1, then lower MAE. Select epoch within each seed; average both fixed seeds for each architecture; select architecture by ensemble metric, keeping accuracy_v3 if no improvement.
validation_policy: Previously used validation selects epochs and architecture, so scores and bootstrap intervals are descriptive and selection-biased, not independent test estimates.
test_policy: Do not evaluate official test or use its labels; extract train and valid only from combined competition pickle.
